questions.question: The sentence with correct punctuation.
options: Maria,My student is on leave today.

questions.question: The best passive form of the sentence "we don’t like idle people"-
options: We are not liked by idle People
Idle people are not like us.
Idle people are not liked by us.
Idle people are not of our liking
questions.explanation: এ বাক্যটি  present indefinite tense দ্বারা গঠিত। সে কারনে এ tense এর negative বাক্যের passive voice এর গঠন হচ্ছে sub+be+not+v(p.p)+by+obj

questions.question: The correct sentence of the following:
options: The Nile is longest the river in Africa.
The Nile is longest river in the Africa
Nile is longest river in Africa
The Nile is the longest river in Africa
questions.explanation: Nile-নীলনদ। যেকোনো নদীর নামের পূর্বে The বসে। আবার longest শব্দটি  superlative বলে এর পূর্বেও the বসবে।

questions.question: The correct sentence of the following:
options: A new cabinet has been sworn in Dhaka
A new cabinet has been swron at Dhaka
A new cabinet has been Sowron by Dhaka
A new cabinet has sworn in Dhaka.
questions.explanation: swear(প্রতিজ্ঞা /শপথ গ্রহণ করা),  এই কাজটি cabinet নিজে করেনা।প্রধান বিচারপতি বা প্রেসিডেন্ট শপথ গ্রহণ করা। তাই বাক্যটি passive voice হবে।
